# Presentations with officekit

Use the `officekit` MCP server tools to create and edit `.pptx` files directly.
All positions and sizes are **inches**. A 16:9 slide is **13.33 × 7.5** inches.
Every tool call saves the file atomically, so edits can be batched.

## Workflow

1. **New deck**: `pptx_create(path)`, then add slides one by one.
   **Existing deck**: `pptx_inspect(path)` FIRST — it returns slide count,
   layouts, every shape with its placeholder type, position and text.
2. `pptx_add_slide(path, layout)` — layout names (substring match works):
   `Title Slide`, `Title and Content`, `Two Content`, `Comparison`,
   `Section Header`, `Title Only`, `Blank`, `Content with Caption`,
   `Picture with Caption`. Returns the new slide index (1-based).
3. Fill placeholders with `pptx_set_text(path, slide, placeholder, paragraphs)`:
   - `placeholder`: `"title"`, `"subtitle"`, `"body"` / `"content"`, or a shape
     `name` from `pptx_inspect`.
   - Each paragraph: `{ text, level?, bullet?, bold?, italic?, size? (pt),
     color? ("RRGGBB"), align? ("left"|"center"|"right") }`.
   - Bullet lists: several paragraphs, `level` 0–4 for nesting.
     `bullet: false` removes the bullet.
4. `pptx_add_image(path, slide, image_path, x?, y?, w?, h?, z?)` — png/jpg/gif.
   With no size it scales to fit the slide preserving aspect ratio and centers.
   Give only `w` (or `h`) to keep the aspect ratio automatically.
   `z: "back"` puts the image **behind** existing shapes — use it for a
   full-bleed background before adding text on top.
5. `pptx_add_textbox(path, slide, x, y, w, h, paragraphs)` for free text.
6. `pptx_duplicate_slide` / `pptx_delete_slide` to restructure.
   `pptx_extract_text(path)` to read a deck's content.

## Design rules

- One idea per slide. Title ≤ 6–8 words; body ≤ 5 bullets of ≤ 2 lines.
- Title sizes 28–40pt, body 18–24pt, captions/footers 10–12pt.
- Full-bleed image: x=0, y=0, w=13.33, h=7.5. Half-slide image: w≈6.
  Picture with caption layout already reserves space.
- Keep 0.5in margins; don't overlap the title zone (top 1.5in).
- Images found on the web: download to a local file first, verify it is a real
  png/jpg (officekit will reject webp/svg with a clear error), then insert.
- Consistent accent color across the deck; dark text on light slides.

## Common patterns

- **Title slide**: layout `Title Slide` → set `title` + `subtitle`.
- **Bullets slide**: layout `Title and Content` → set `title` + `body`
  paragraphs with levels.
- **Image slide**: layout `Blank` or `Picture with Caption` → add image
  (auto-fit) + `pptx_add_textbox` caption at the bottom (y≈6.8, size 12).
- **Background image with text on top**: add the image with `z: "back"`
  (full-bleed: x=0, y=0, w=13.33, h=7.5) first or after the text — `z: "back"`
  puts it behind everything either way.
- **Section break**: layout `Section Header`.
- **Edit an existing deck**: inspect → set_text on specific shapes → save;
  never guess placeholder names — read them from `pptx_inspect`.
